boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on or beside Livernois and West McNichols near the McNichols Campus, each with one directly supported reason to stop.

cards.title: Coffee, smoothies, and tea
cards.subtitle: Livernois Avenue corridor — 19331 Livernois Ave.
cards.notes: Walk north on Livernois to order coffee, baked goods, a smoothie, or loose-leaf tea; the café lists weekday and Saturday daytime hours.
cards.short_summary: A daytime café stop on the Avenue of Fashion.
cards.evidence_claim: The Narrow Way Cafe & Shop lists coffee, baked goods, smoothies, loose-leaf tea, and its address at 19331 Livernois Avenue.
cards.source_title: The Narrow Way Cafe & Shop — Location
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Monday–Saturday, 8 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed Sunday.

cards.title: A chicken-and-waffles meal
cards.subtitle: Livernois Avenue corridor — 19345 Livernois Ave.
cards.notes: Head along Livernois for a sit-down or carryout meal at this restaurant; confirm its current Tuesday–Sunday schedule before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant with dine-in and carryout service on Livernois.
cards.evidence_claim: Kuzzo's Chicken & Waffles lists its location at 19345 Livernois Avenue and identifies carryout apps alongside listed operating hours.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Tuesday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–8 p.m.; Sunday, 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; closed Monday.

cards.title: Bakery treats and cake slices
cards.subtitle: Livernois Avenue corridor — 19363 Livernois Ave.
cards.notes: Continue on Livernois for cookies, cupcakes, cake slices, and other bakery items; use the bakery’s location page to check the day’s hours.
cards.short_summary: A Livernois bakery offering individual treats and celebration cakes.
cards.evidence_claim: Good Cakes & Bakes lists its Detroit shop at 19363 Livernois Avenue and publishes Tuesday–Saturday hours.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Tuesday, 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; Wednesday–Friday, 9 a.m.–6 p.m.; Saturday, 8 a.m.–6 p.m.

cards.title: Framed art and collectibles
cards.subtitle: Livernois Avenue corridor — 19376 Livernois Ave.
cards.notes: Visit this Livernois gallery to browse framed art, prints, gifts, and collectibles, or ask about its custom-framing services during gallery hours.
cards.short_summary: An art gallery and framing shop on Livernois.
cards.evidence_claim: Jo's Gallery identifies itself at 19376 Livernois Avenue and lists curated artist collections, framed art, gifts, and custom framing.
cards.access_notes: The site lists gallery hours Tuesday–Saturday, 11 a.m.–6:30 p.m.; closed Monday and Sunday.

cards.title: Art, masks, and sculptures
cards.subtitle: Livernois Avenue corridor — 19500 Livernois Ave.
cards.notes: Walk north on Livernois to view framed art, prints, sculptures, masks, and artifacts; the gallery also offers photo printing and framing.
cards.short_summary: A family-owned gallery with art and framing services.
cards.evidence_claim: Sherwood Forest Art Gallery lists its address at 19500 Livernois and describes framed art, prints, sculptures, masks, artifacts, and custom framing.
cards.access_notes: Contact the gallery before visiting to confirm current showroom availability.

cards.title: Mexican food on Livernois
cards.subtitle: Livernois Avenue corridor — 19329 Livernois Ave.
cards.notes: Choose the Livernois location for Mexican food and place an order or dine in during its posted Monday–Saturday service window.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican restaurant on the Livernois commercial corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Pequeño Cantina lists a Livernois location at 19329 Livernois in Detroit and publishes Monday–Saturday hours.
cards.access_notes: Listed Livernois hours: Monday–Saturday, 11 a.m.–10 p.m.; closed Sunday.

cards.title: Detroit jazz history
cards.subtitle: Livernois Avenue corridor — 20510 Livernois Ave.
cards.notes: Travel farther north on Livernois to document the exterior of this long-running music venue; check its official calendar before planning a show.
cards.short_summary: A historic Livernois music venue with a published events calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: Baker's Keyboard Lounge identifies itself as a Detroit jazz venue and lists its location at 20510 Livernois Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Review the official events calendar and venue policies before attending.

cards.title: Marygrove campus programming
cards.subtitle: West McNichols Road corridor — 8425 W. McNichols Rd.
cards.notes: Go west on McNichols to see the Marygrove campus and use the conservancy’s program listings to find a public event or activity.
cards.short_summary: A nearby campus with conservancy-led programs and events.
cards.evidence_claim: Marygrove Conservancy lists its Detroit campus address at 8425 West McNichols Road and publishes community programs and events.
cards.access_notes: Program access varies; consult the conservancy’s event details before visiting.

cards.title: A landmark beside campus
cards.subtitle: West McNichols Road corridor — 17180 Oak Dr., at Livernois
cards.notes: Use the corner opposite the McNichols Campus to photograph Gesu’s exterior or attend a listed public liturgy; check the parish schedule first.
cards.short_summary: A parish landmark directly beside the Livernois–McNichols campus corner.
cards.evidence_claim: Gesu Catholic Church lists its Detroit address at 17180 Oak Drive and publishes parish Mass and event information.
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing is generally possible from public sidewalks; consult the parish schedule for services and events.

cards.title: A coffeehouse stop west of campus
cards.subtitle: West McNichols Road corridor — 7420 W. McNichols Rd.
cards.notes: Head west on McNichols for a coffeehouse stop, then verify current service details directly with Detroit Sip before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A named coffeehouse destination on West McNichols.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Equity’s University District guide identifies Detroit Sip at 7420 West McNichols Road.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current hours and ordering options with the business before visiting.

warnings: No coordinates, map links, or source publication dates were set where they were not directly verified.
